title: Geologic map of the Saluda quadrangle, Greenville County, South Carolina
citation: Garihan, J.M., Clendenin, C.W., and Ranson, W.A., 2010, Geologic map of the Saluda quadrangle, Greenville County, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Geologic Quadrangle Map GQM-48, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: Single OCR'd Inner Piedmont / Blue Ridge Front map sheet with major findings, unit descriptions, photo captions and several cross sections (A-A', B-B', D-D', E-E'); the OCR interleaves columns heavily. Units and faults recorded from legible text; many symbols not legible. Faults named in the text and abbreviation list are recorded; the Rocky Spur fault label is garbled ('Gsciall Galt fis Rocky Souctiult') and not recorded; 'Tillee Moantain fault' in the list is read from the clearer 'Tillet Mountain fault' text. Cross sections of crystalline units with faults and folds, no drill holes; they were not traced from the images (no subsurface depth data beyond unit geometry), only names, datum and legible unit labels recorded. Hogback Mountain summit elevation 3,211 ft and Hoghead Mountain 850 m (photo captions) are topographic, not recorded. Numerous foliation and lineation symbols on the map face not readable. Howard (2001) and Hatcher (2004) cited in text but not in the reference list. SUBSURFACE: crystalline-rock sections with fault and fold geometry only; no tops or bases of units recorded.
